maria_csm: Heads up — NimbusOps (mid-market) dropped ~40% DAU on inference calls over the last 10 days. Renewal in ~8 weeks. Onboarding note: semantic search not adopted; they still hit simple keyword fallback. Thinking a short stabilization plan to avoid churn — re-engage + enable + cost relief. Any quick ideas?
ajay_csops: Can you share the usage snapshot and primary contact? Any changes in NPS/CSAT?
maria_csm: Summary: peak ~9k/day -> ~5.4k/day. Search requests down 60%. Contact: Priya (Head of ML). Last touch: onboarding workshop 3 weeks ago. CSAT steady but lower qualitative feedback about "noisy results".
lenore_success: Proposal: 2-week stabilization sprint: 1) 100k token burst credit for reindex & testing; 2) 45min SRE/SE deep-dive for search prompts; 3) prescriptive prompt pack + measurement checklist; 4) day-10 quality check & decision gate. Also offer a canary on a smaller quantized variant to cut cost if they're sensitive.
darren_eng: From infra: we can recommend m-quant-1 for search (3-5x cheaper) + enable prefix KV caching during reindex to speed up. We'll provide a config snippet to run background reindex with safe batching.
devbot: Promo code created: NIMBUS-BURST-1781 (100k tokens, expires in 21 days) :white_check_mark:
ajay_csops: I'll own outreach cadence. Plan: Day 0 announcement + Day 3 enable + Day 8 check-in + Day 14 review. Who volunteers for the deep-dive?
karen_sales: I can draft the outreach + short-term credits approval note for finance. Also will include a simple downgrade-safe clause if they request it. Draft email template below.
lenore_success: I'll run the enablement and deliver the prompt pack + top 8 queries by EOD tomorrow. I'll also include a short A/B test to compare m-quant-1 vs default.
maria_csm: Quick feedback-survey we'll push at day 7. Questions: 1) Which search flow matters most? 2) Did results match expectations? 3) Any blockers? Keep it 3 Qs.

Maria + Redwood team
